QueueStartingPosition.description: The starting position in the source stream from which the queue reads records.

Timestamp.description: The timestamp to start reading from. Required when Type is AT_TIMESTAMP; the timestamp must not be in the future.

Tag.description: An arbitrary set of tags (key-value pairs) to associate with the Kinesis queue.

Value.description: The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 255 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

Key.description: The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

DeadLetterConfiguration.description: Configuration controlling where records are sent after exceeding the maximum receive count.

MaxReceiveCount.description: The maximum number of times a record can be received before it is moved to the dead-letter target. Required when TargetType is BUILT_IN.

TargetType.description: The dead-letter target type. BUILT_IN uses a service-managed dead-letter target; NONE disables dead-lettering.

QueueAttributes.description: Mutable attributes that control queue consumption behavior.

VisibilityTimeoutSeconds.description: The duration, in seconds, that a received record is hidden from subsequent receive calls after being handed out to a consumer. Defaults to 30 seconds.

DeadLetterConfiguration.description: The dead-letter configuration applied to records that exceed the maximum receive count.

QueueStreamConfiguration.description: The configuration of the Kinesis stream that the queue reads from.

StartingPosition.description: The position in the stream from which the queue starts reading records.

StreamARN.description: The Amazon resource name (ARN) of the Kinesis data stream that the queue reads from.

QueueCreationTimestamp.description: Timestamp of when the queue was created.

StreamConfigurationList.description: List of stream configurations associated with the queue. v1 supports a single element; the list shape allows future extensibility to fan in from multiple streams.

QueueName.description: The name of the queue. The name's uniqueness is scoped per AWS account and region.

QueueAttributes.description: Mutable attributes that control queue consumption behavior.

Tags.description: An arbitrary set of tags (key-value pairs) to associate with the Kinesis queue.
